title: is_action_just_pressed_by_event doesn't work for mouse button events
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.stable and 4.5.1.stable
- Not reproducible in: any prior version; `is_action_just_pressed_by_event` was introduced in 4.5

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

`is_action_just_pressed_by_event` always returns false when the given event type is `InputEventMouseButton`. Other input sources seem to work fine.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new project, add a script, add an `_input` method overload, print some text if `is_action_just_pressed_by_event` returns true for the current event and some arbitrary action (for instance, "press"), define the action in input maps, and bind it to any mouse button. Once in-game, pressing that mouse button will not execute the print statement, but if other input sources are bound to that action, things are printed to the console just fine.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Left click, spacebar, and (A) on an xbox controller layout are all bound to an action, yet `_input` never prints anything when a mouse click happens, unlike the other input methods.
